payload.description: How many licence applications Norwich decides in a year, and how many it turns down. The officer's report to the March 2026 committee counts the licences in force but not the decisions behind them, and the council publishes no annual licensing report. We have not brought any national licensing statistics into the archive either, so no figures from elsewhere appear here.
